referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for an office building with offices, kitchen, restaurant and car park. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 7492 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 42500 m3/h, total weight of the components: 10121 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 5.7 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: eb47096f-614c-3e18-a294-169c98a8bca6
